subject: lavaGolem
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: lava golem of basalt plates and molten seams.
Style: Genshin Impact.
reasoning:
I'm designing a compact lava golem model with a cel-shaded toon aesthetic, glowing molten seams, a glowing chest core, and rune decals, keeping it rich but efficient in code size.

I'm laying out the skeleton with hips as the root, a spine chain running to chest, neck, and head, plus leg and arm limbs built from joints and chains, working out approximate proportions (height ~2.8, shoulders at ±0.8, feet near ground) and setting up an A-pose stance for the arms.

For the body geometry, I'm thinking flat-shaded dodecahedron and icosahedron shapes for rocky plates, painted with mottled basalt grays and lighter plate tones, with an inner glowing orange lava core visible through gaps between the armor plates.

I'll add a helper function for generating boxy rotated plates around bones for the faceted armor look, plus glowing seam strips on the chest. For facial details, I'm planning glowing yellow slit eyes and a chest rune as textured plane decals layered on top.

Now I'm building the leg chains with named joints (hip, knee, ankle) mirrored for both sides, sweeping thick basalt-colored geometry along the path, then layering armor plates with lava gaps at the knee and a boxy foot at the ankle.

Building the arm joint chains with named shoulder/elbow/wrist joints, adding big icosahedron fists with lava knuckle glow, stacked pauldron plates on the shoulder, and simple cheap finger/thumb boxes under each wrist for the separated-digits look.

Now designing the head: a blocky basalt helmet shape with a brow ridge, glowing eye decals, and a lower jaw box with lava mouth glow, plus a jaw joint and horn placements to work out.

Adding horns, back spikes, shoulder spikes, lava vents with orange glow, molten drip spheres on the fists, and considering flame crest cards above the head using glowing textured planes.

Now I'm setting up the color palette—basalt grays, dark tones, and lava glow colors (orange, bright yellow-orange, ember red)—using cel-shaded and mottled paints for texture, then moving to the hips and waist with a belt plate and a glowing lava core cylinder between chest and hips.

For the torso, I'm placing an icosahedron glow core inside the chest with plate armor around it—front slabs split to leave a gap showing the molten core, plus a back plate and shoulder yoke—then positioning a glowing rune plane in that chest gap, working out the exact spacing so the rune sits visible between the plates.

Now I'm setting up helper functions for building box and rock geometry parts.

Still planning joint structure...

I'm defining the spine chain using a catmull curve through three points to create spine, chest, and neck joints, then attaching the neck with its own direction and role, before moving on to positioning the head.

Placing the head and jaw joints using explicit world-space coordinates so their orientation doesn't need to match local directions, and sizing the head small relative to the golem's bulky shoulders.

Adding the jaw box with a glowing lava mouth, then a single textured plane for both eyes across the face instead of mirroring separate geometries, plus a brow ridge box above them.

For horns, I'm using a spike helper for each side with dark bone material, tilted outward and back. Then I'm adding a row of back crystal spikes along the spine with alternating offsets and a lava-colored glow.

Now for shoulders, I'm building pauldrons with icosahedron rock plates scaled asymmetrically, stacking a second tier plate plus three small spikes on top, and ringing the joint with a thin glowing lava torus.

For the arms, I'm placing bracer plates at the forearm midpoint oriented along the elbow-to-wrist direction, then adding a scaled rock fist at the wrist with a glowing lava knuckle band...

Adding finger joints and rods...

Now I'm shrinking the fist to a smaller radius centered at the wrist, repositioning fingers to extend below it, then moving to the legs: building the foot as a box with a toe slab and lava heel glow, setting the ankle joint target, and sizing the calf and thigh sweeps.

Knee gets a rock cap and glow ring torus, thighs get plated panels with lava seam strips. The pelvis is a box with hip bones, a thin glowing lava belt, a glowing waist core sphere, and stacked ab plates with gaps revealing the core underneath before moving up into the chest/back plate.

Now I'm adding the chest front plates and yoke, then designing a custom cracked-lava paint function that uses cell noise to detect crack boundaries and color them orange over a darker basalt base.

For flames, I'm placing flame-shaped cards as a crown around the head using frame positioning tied to the head bone, with slight randomized variation and a glow effect applied to the meshes.

Now I'm designing the rune texture as an SVG with a glowing orange ring and triangular rune lines on a transparent background, plus a chest glow plane. For the eyes, I'm making a slim SVG with slanted yellow slits and orange outlines over a transparent plane so the dark head shows through everywhere except the slits. I'm checking total figure height and ground contact before finalizing the code with the card options for size, lean, flow, and bone attachment.
